com.adups.fota.why: Adups OTA client - Firebase tracking, the vendor behind the 2016 data-collection scandal; this unit gets no OTAs

com.adups.fota.sysoper.why: Helper for the Adups OTA client

com.abfota.systemUpdate.why: Second OTA client (Redstone) - starts at boot, can reboot the unit; vendor updates come by USB anyway

com.baidu.map.location.why: Sends Wi-Fi/cell data to Baidu for location; Google Play services already does this

com.hcn.log.why: Log uploader - reads system logs, location and MAC address and sends them online

com.mediatek.duraspeed.why: MediaTek DuraSpeed kills background apps - can stop Spotify or Maps in the background

com.android.bookmarkprovider.why: Browser bookmarks - no stock browser here

com.android.providers.partnerbookmarks.why: Partner bookmarks - no stock browser here

com.hcn.changedapp.why: Factory test app (touch/LCD/ageing tests), starts at boot, 38 MB - usually safe to disable

com.hcn.screensaver.why: Vendor screensaver - disable if it covers the clock when idle

com.hcn.autobarcode.why: Barcode/QR scanner - not needed day to day

com.hcn.AutoMediaPlayer.why: Vendor music player - keep if you play music from USB

com.hcn.gallery.why: Vendor photo viewer - keep if you view photos/videos from USB

com.hcn.autosetting.why: Car Settings - needed for the unit's car config

com.hcn.autocan.why: CAN bus car info (doors, A/C, etc.)

com.hcn.themepicker.why: Theme for the stock launcher (your backup home)

com.mediatek.filemanager.why: File manager - you need it to install APKs

com.android.providers.calendar.why: Calendar storage used by Google sync

com.mediatek.engineermode.why: Hidden test menu - does not run in the background
